body:
I used to take cordicidine cough and cold and drink robotussin max strength when I was 15. I usaully took about 10 at a time then I got more used to it and started takin 12-16 at a time. It was a great unexplainable feeling. One time I took 25 of those little red pills and had to go to the hospital in an ambulance because my parents found me high as hell and I told them how many I took. I didnt't care that I had to go there. I didn't care that I had the blood pressure of a 64 year old man. I was 'trippin balls'. It was just a crazy dream to me. I took so many of those damn pills. I used to drink so much of that disgusting tussin.
I used to come onnline and look at all the information that would make me crave the sh*t. Now I come to you three years later to tell you that I now can only eat about one or two small meals a day. All that medicine I took at once over about a 7 month period ate all the lining off of my stomach. I can never get that back. You don't grow if you dont eat. Not to mention how I get sick just about every morning. Now I just have the memories of a stupid little boy that wanted to get high regardless of what he was doing to himself.
